recipe.description: These diner-style cheeseburgers have gooey melted cheese and all the fixings - the ultimate American beef burgers for a barbecue feast
recipe.name: Best cheeseburgers
recipe.headline: Best cheeseburgers
recipe.keywords: 1 of 5-a-day, 10-30 minutes, 4 servings, 800 kcal or less, American burger, Barbecue, beef burger recipe, Calcium, Folate, Indulgent, Jennifer Joyce, slider, Summer
recipe.recipeCategory: Dinner, Lunch, Main course, Supper, Treat
recipeIngredient: 4 large soft brioche buns (available in Marks & Spencer and Waitrose) or burger buns, halved
16 Bread & butter pickles (see Goes well with) or 2 gherkins thinly sliced

recipeInstructions.text: Put the meat and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl and season with black pepper and 1 generous tsp salt. Mix together well, then shape the meat into 4 thin, flat burgers. Chill until needed. Can be made a day ahead. Combine the chipotle paste, ketchup and mayonnaise in a bowl to make a sauce.

Heat a gas or charcoal barbecue to high (or you can use a griddle pan on the hob). Cook the burgers over direct heat for 2 mins each side or until grill marks appear. Top each with 2 slices of cheese and cook for another 30 secs or until melted, then remove from the heat. Toast the buns for a few seconds on the cut-side.
Spread a little of the spicy sauce on the base of each bun and top with lettuce, tomato, a burger patty, onion and pickles. Top with the bun lid and devour immediately.
